scientific_integrity: An all-parameter combinatorial case proof is supplied. Finite independent programs corroborate, not replace, the proof. No independent audit or priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to line graphs of double-broom trees with two or more leaves attached to each spine endpoint; does not establish exact refinement depth, general tree line graphs, or graph identification; priority comparison may be incomplete.
title: A unique colour-refinement obstruction among all double-broom line graphs
